opening.argument: The material directs viewers to transfer AVAX to a smart contract, pay a gas fee, and activate a flash-loan function while presenting rapid trading as a path to profit. It expressly instructs viewers to "copy my contract address and send over eleven point 23 a backs" and says, "we're going to hit flash loan and that's going to Start actually the process." The promised return is tied directly to that transfer: viewers are told that "we should see the profits hit in real time," while the description says, "TO EARN MORE THAN THE AMOUNT IN THE VIDEO YOU CAN INCREASE GAS FEE." The tutorial therefore links an asset transfer and increasing payment to claimed trading returns. The separate staking advertisement is not part of this mechanism.
